title: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Ordinance 1985

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1985
WEST PAKISTAN MATERNITY BENEFIT (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance further to amend the West
Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Maternity
Benefit (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6, W. P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1985
WEST PAKISTAN MATERNITY BENEFIT (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance further to amend the West
Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment of section b, W.
P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1985.-In the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit
Ordinance, 1958 (W. P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958), hereinafter referred to as
the said Ordinance, in section 6,--
(a) in subsection (1), for the commas, words, semicolon, brackets
and figures ", if the newly born child survives her, to the person who
under takes the care of the child ; and, if the child does not survive her, to
the person nominated by her under subsection (1) of section 5, or, if she has
made no such nomination, to her legal representative "the words, brackets,
figures and commas" to the person nominated by her under subsection (1) of
section 5 for the benefit of all her legal representatives, or, if she has made
no such nomination, to all her legal representatives" shall be substituted
; and
(b) in subsection (2), for the
commas and words ", or, if she has made no such nomination to her legal
representative" the words and commas
1. "for the benefit of all her legal representatives, or,
if she has made no such nomination, to all her legal representatives"
shall be substituted.

An Ordinance further to amend the West

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
3. Amendment of section 11, W. P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958.-In
the said Ordinance, in section 11,-
(a) after the
word "woman", occurring for the first time, the words "or the
person nominated by her or any of her legal representatives shall be inserted ;
(b) for the
words "employer or a woman", occurring for the second time, the word
"applicant" shall be substituted ; and
(c) after the words "such
appeal", the commas and words "`which shall be taken after affording
to the applicant an opportunity of being heard," shall be inserted.
